name: Hamla
description:
Hamla is an AI marketing team that plugs into whatever a business already uses — e-commerce stores, SaaS companies, clinics, restaurants, agencies — across every industry, market, and language. Connect your Hamla account and Claude can run personalized marketing across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, popups, on-site notifications, and Instagram/Facebook auto-replies: read performance and attribution, manage contacts and segments, and build campaigns, reports, plans, and decks in plain language.

Every campaign this server creates is a draft. controlCampaign refuses launch, resume, and schedule — the three actions that put a campaign live and send real messages — so there is no path through this server that reaches a real customer without a person approving it in the Hamla dashboard. Contact writes are staged the same way: importContacts and grantConsent default to preview-only and write nothing until you confirm, and grantConsent refuses outright unless the business has explicitly attested it has permission to contact the list.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE — sign in with your own Hamla account and Claude acts as you, scoped to your normal permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hamla to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hamla to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.hamla.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hamla MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hamla lists 34 MCP tools, including addSlide, archiveDesignTemplate, campaignCalendar, checkAlerts, controlCampaign, createCampaign, createSegment, deleteSegment, describeContact, editCampaign, editDesignTemplate, and editSegment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hamla?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hamla in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Hamla requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hamla is developed by Hamla. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
